about_the_game:
Italian Brainrot: Arena is a multiplayer shooter crafted on Unreal Engine 5, inspired by the viral meme characters from the Brainrot Italian Animals universe. Dive into battle solo or team up with friends across diverse maps, facing off against other players in a variety of thrilling game modes.

Game Modes Overview:

  • Domination: A team-based mode where players fight to capture and hold key points on the map. The longer your team controls these points, the more points you score.

  • Free for All: Every player for themselves in this classic mode, where the top killer claims victory.

  • Gun Game: Progress through a series of weapons with each kill. Be the first to master every weapon to win.

  • Skirmish: Fast-paced, tactical battles with limited players and respawn options.

  • Deathmatch: A classic team showdown where two squads compete to reach a target kill count.

Choose Your Champion

Pick your favorite character from the Italian Animals universe, including fan-favorites like Bombardiro Crocodilo, Tralalero Tralala, Ballerina Cappuccina, Bobrito Bandito, Lirili Larila, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, and many more.

Every Match is Unique

Dynamic balance and each character’s distinct tactical abilities ensure no two matches are the same. Master your hero’s unique skills, learn the maps, and refine your playstyle to dominate the battlefield.

Deep Customization System

Fine-tune your weapons down to the smallest details. Select sights, grips, barrels, magazines, and other mods to craft the perfect loadout for your playstyle. Experiment with module combinations to balance accuracy, fire rate, and mobility.

Tactical Loadout Choices

Before each match, build a custom arsenal from a wide range of primary and secondary weapons, grenades, and special gear. Adapt on the fly by swapping loadouts at respawn points to counter the evolving battlefield dynamics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
